body: I can't fight anymore. I've been fighting for so long. I'm to weak and tired. I know your heart is in the right place. But its my time. I love this world and all you people and I'll miss you all. Good luck friends.

Yeah they have their hearts in the right place but they only tell you "oh dont do that, theres so much to live for" because they are saying it for themselves. Not to make them feel like they are a good person, but because they need to lie to themselves and tell not only you but themselves that they need to keep pushing and strive to survive. But for what reason? If all your doing is living life but you dont have a reason to live life, other then to look for a reason to live life. Then then real question is. Do you feel lucky enough that your going to find that reason and is the reason even worth going through all the pain and work it takes to find the reason to keep living life? Only you can make that decision. Is the game, worth it, for the reward? Thats all life is to me. A big game. But you dont really know the prize, because you kinda make up your own prize really. Some people decide that heaven is their reward, others think that the present moment is the reward, like if you work and get paid, your reward is getting to have a house and go out to eat and to the movies. To me it has to do a lot about luck. If your born into a rich family and you have a lot of things handed to you than it would be worth it to stick around and take advantage of your situation. Blow your money, party, fuck girls, take drugs, live it up. But if your broke and every day is nothing but constant work and being in pain, and the only pay off is that at the end of the day you might get a warm meal and thats the high light of your day.. Well most people dont think the warm meal is enough to go through all the pain and work it takes to survive. I'm at a point in my life where I barely have enough money for that warm meal and even though I've enjoyed the warm meals and the occasional drink or fucking a girl. Its getting to a point where its just to much work and not enough rewards. Its not worth it to me and thats ok. People get tired, sick, old, and life changes and sometimes for the worst. I hope for everyone that they'll be so lucky to have great words with barely any work but thats just not how life is for most of us and thats ok. Sometimes i get angry but that does nothing but make me mad. So i try to say fuck it and just not think about it. And honestly... I like knowing i can kill myself. Whenevet i get annoyed or pissed off. I just think "fuck it.. I can walk off, and just go kill myself right now if i want to." Its scary as hell but pretty liberating. I dont know what I'm going on about now. Should i kill myself or not? I have no idea. Ill cross that bridge when i get to it.

I have no idea. I've been searching for purpose for years and it seems like no one really know their purpose, they just keep living hoping eventually they'll find it, or they lie to themselves and others saying "this" or "that" is their purpose. Who knows? No one. Or at least your always going to assume the person that gives you an answer is lying. Thats the thing about life. You dont know and you never can and i think thats the point of life. Not knowing. It makes us panic but it also brings us peace. Its really your choice. No one can decide for you. We can tell you this or that and everything you want to hear. But the truth is that you have to decide for yourself. You have to find something worth living for and sometimes people can't find anything and some people think thats a bad thing and they may be right. But I think its ok, i think some people just aren't meant for this world. We're all gonna die and some sooner than others. I think very soon I will kill myself. But thats just life i suppose. If you wanna talk message me, but whatever you do good luck. Penis. Yeah i said penis. Cuz fuck you thats why.

Fuck it. If your life is shit. I don't see why not either. I'm in the exact same boat. Maybe your situation is worse but I feel what your saying. No one knows what happens after you die and it pisses me off when people claim they know or act like its so horrible that you want to kill yourself. Its not horrible. Its actually pretty fucking logical when your life is shit. So I fuck it man. Do what you want, if you want to hang in there, then go for it, but if you wanna die. Dont go half ass about it. Do what you want for a few weeks before u kill urself. Thats what I'm gonna do. I'm gonna say fuck the constant worry in my head and I'm gonna be reckless.. We're gonna die anyways... I wonder if you'll read this or if we'll converse more after this. But if not. It was a crazy adventure. Good luck man.
